info.title: Diavgis Procurement API
info.description: Read API over normalized Greek public-procurement acts, resolved entities, and reconstructed lifecycle chains. Sources: Διαύγεια, ΚΗΜΔΗΣ (Central Electronic Public Procurement Registry) and EU TED — cross-linked into one dataset. Natural-person counterparties are redacted.

200.description: Links to the release packages, record packages and daily releases

get.summary: OCDS releases published on one day (no API key)
OCDS release package of one act (no API key)
OCDS record package of one contracting process (no API key)

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: restrict to acts issued in this 4-digit year

parameters.name: deadline_after
parameters.description: open tenders whose submission deadline is on/after this date

parameters.name: single_bidder
parameters.description: only acts where <=1 bid was submitted

parameters.name: cancelled
parameters.description: only source-cancelled acts; by DEFAULT cancelled and superseded acts are excluded from every list

parameters.name: has_chain
parameters.description: only acts linked into a reconstructed lifecycle chain

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: capped by the plan's pagination depth; beyond it returns 403 page_limit

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: server-side ordering across the WHOLE matched set. deadline = soonest first, with no-deadline and already-expired acts last; amount = largest first. Without it you can only sort the page you fetched.

parameters.name: flat
parameters.description: opt out of grouping: one row per PUBLICATION instead of one per procurement

discount.description: Contractor discount, only on tenders and on public-works (CPV 45) awards/contracts. The key is ABSENT when there is nothing to show (not null). basis "document" = the percentage exactly as the award decision states it (measure average_discount | discount_on_budget, with document_ref and document_url to the source), Pro plan and above. basis "calculated" = Diavgis' own 1 - award_net / tender_budget_net, single winner only, shown only when the award is 30-100% of the budget and, where the document states a figure, within 1 point of it. official_locked: true + upgrade_url = the document states an official figure this plan does not include. Never present a calculated value as the official one.
